verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents its own recurring background mechanisms. Alert rules evaluate any SQL query on a set interval and fire Slack or HTTP webhook destinations. Refreshable materialized views also carry over from ClickHouse. These are narrow, query-centric automations rather than a general automation or agent-task scheduler. Batch jobs are one-off operations, not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduled or triggered workflows beyond alerting and view refresh, autonomous agent tasks running in the background, documentation of how refreshable view schedules are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Turn any SQL query against your cluster into a monitored rule: set an operator, threshold, interval, and severity, start from a template
Organization-scoped, reusable Slack and HTTP webhook destinations you set up once and attach to any rule.
